definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese clothing such as kimono, yukata, and hakama, as distinguished from Western clothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和服|わふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people wear traditional Japanese clothes at coming-of-age ceremonies.

examples.japanese: {和服|わふく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which do you prefer, Japanese or Western clothes?

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{和服|わふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother wears traditional Japanese clothes every day.

notes:
USAGE: {和服|わふく} is a formal term for traditional Japanese clothing, contrasted with ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧ (Western clothes).

TYPES OF {和服|わふく}:
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧ - kimono (general term)
- ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧ - yukata (casual summer kimono)
- ⟦{袴|はかま}→袴：02245_hakama⟧ - hakama (traditional pants/skirt)
- ⟦{羽織|はおり}→羽織：05712_haori⟧ - haori (short coat worn over kimono)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {和服|わふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to wear Japanese clothes)
- {和服|わふく}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (dressed in Japanese clothes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和服|わふく} vs ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧ - Japanese vs Western clothing
- ⟦{和|わ}→和：13041_wa⟧ prefix indicates 'Japanese-style'
